Complete capability index

Source: ECOSYSTEM-INDEX.md

Every exported function of every package surveyed in ECOSYSTEM.md, sorted into sixteen capability categories. Generated by ecosystem/make_index.py from ecosystem/atlas.json; raw enumerations are in ecosystem/*.tsv.

Interactive version: tmp/capability-index.html (searchable and filterable — open tmp/capability-index.html).

3,556 functions across 34 packages. Category assignment is curated by hand for the eleven packages where the distinction carries the argument and by name-pattern rule elsewhere. Temporal centrality counts only time-respecting definitions — a static formula recomputed per slice is filed under Static centrality, Dynet’s own included.

Who implements time-respecting centrality

The scarcest capability in the field — 17 functions across 4 packages.

  • betweenness — Dynet
  • closeness — Dynet
  • dyn_centrality — Dynet
  • reach — Dynet
  • reach_count — Dynet
  • tDegree — tsna
  • temporal_betweenness_centrality — teneto
  • temporal_closeness_centrality — teneto
  • temporal_degree_centrality — teneto
  • temporal_participation_coeff — teneto
  • Temporal Katz — TGLib
  • Temporal PageRank — TGLib
  • Temporal closeness — TGLib
  • Temporal edge betweenness — TGLib
  • Temporal walk centrality — TGLib
  • Top-k closeness (min. duration) — TGLib
  • Top-k closeness (shortest) — TGLib
